changes.to: Maker is Wuhan HandX Innovation Technology (武汉手智创新). Its WRC 2026 exhibitor entry describes Yuanyou as a wheeled general-purpose humanoid combining dexterous hands with multi-dimensional sensing for fine grasping, moxibustion therapy and daily assistance, aimed at civil services and industrial assistance, but publishes no numbers. People's Daily (29 Jan 2026) quotes HandX's general manager: 158 cm, 72 kg, 1.5 m/s, 9 months in service at Xianning Central Hospital, in mass production with 4 lines and 1,500 units/year capacity. Those figures are not from a maker datasheet, so the spec fields stay empty.
Wuhan HandX's wheeled service humanoid Yuanyou, working as a hospital guide and moxibustion therapist in Xianning since 2025.
